notablePrerequisites:
Phyrexian Metamorph is a copy of Genesis Chamber.
Enough additional mana and/or artifacts on the battlefield to make up for Emry's command tax (if applicable).
description:
Cast Emry by paying {U} plus commander tax (if applicable).
When Emry enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, Genesis Chamber, and the copy of Genesis Chamber.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Resolve Emry's ability, milling four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Send Emry from the graveyard to the command zone as a state-based action.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times.
